posts.title: Why I use Firefox
posts.description: Questions like “Which browser should I use?” regularly come up on the r/browsers subreddit . I sometimes respond to these posts, but my quick replies usually only contain one or two points. To be honest, until recently I wasn’t even sure myself why I use Firefox.
